_what_this_is: The committed statement of which MuPDF the `fuzz_document_open` recursion-DoS
finding was last confirmed against. Read by tools/gate/check_mupdf_bump_recheck.py,
which FAILS the build when either pin below stops matching vcpkg.json -- that is
GitHub #139's resolution-path step 2 ('on a MuPDF bump, re-run fuzz_document_open
to confirm') made into a control that cannot be silently passed.
Do NOT edit these values to make a red build green. Their only value is that a
human ran the harness. Run it, record what happened in the
PDFE-SEC-MUPDF-RECURSION-DOS entry of tests/docs/known_issues.md, then update here.

last_recheck.outcome: REPRODUCES -- stack exhaustion on a pathologically deep/cyclic page graph. Contained at the app layer by the pdfe_preflight child process; not fixed upstream.
